regulatory_descriptor: A Non-linked Non-Participating Group Life Insurance Plan
key_benefits: Group pure-risk life cover for borrowers / co-borrowers (lender and non-lender groups), Single or Regular Pay
Level Cover (constant sum assured) or Reducing Cover (reduces with outstanding loan)
Optional in-built covers: Accelerated/Additional Critical Illness (11/17/32 CI), Accelerated Terminal Illness, Accelerated Accidental Total Permanent Disability, Accidental Death Benefit
Single life, Joint life (5% joint-life discount), or up to 3 co-borrowers
Benefit Multiplier: cover up to 120% of outstanding loan amount
Death benefit payable in instalments option (up to 10 years); surrender value under specific options only
Optional Health Management Services at no extra cost

eligibility.coverage_term: 1 month to 360 months (Single Pay or Regular Pay)
eligibility.policy_term: Coverage term 1-360 months; member-level term may equal moratorium plus decreasing-cover term
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Single Pay; or Regular Pay (Level Cover PPT=PT, Reducing Cover PPT=2/3 of PT)
eligibility.note: Numeric entry-age / sum-assured eligibility table not recovered from this parse — verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document (electronic or otherwise), except where policy tenure is less than a year.
key_terms.grace_period: Not applicable under Single Premium. Under Regular Premium: 30 days (all modes except monthly), 15 days (monthly).
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death of the Member by suicide within 12 months of commencement of risk or latest revival (whichever is later), nominee receives higher of 80% of Premiums paid till date of death or the surrender value as on date of death; provided the policy/membership is in force. For Joint Life, applies on either member's suicide and terminates both covers.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: There is NO maturity benefit in this plan — it is pure-risk credit/group protection.
key_terms.tax_note: Premiums and benefits 'may be eligible' for tax benefits per extant Income Tax Act, subject to provisions and as amended; consult a tax advisor.

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a pure-risk GROUP plan intended to cover borrowers/co-borrowers — marketing must frame it as credit/loan-protection group insurance, not an individual retail product.
Reducing Cover applies only where the Sum Assured is linked to a loan; Benefit Multiplier (100%-120% of outstanding loan) and moratorium (0-8 yrs) are loan-linked features.
Critical Illness / ATPD / ATI / ADB are OPTIONAL in-built covers chosen at inception with their own sum-assured percentages — any such benefit claim must be flagged as optional and condition-bound.
Surrender value is available only under specific options (e.g. Reducing Cover after PPT, or Single Premium with term >1 year); no surrender value under Regular Premium Level Cover.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as a savings, investment or maturity/'money-back' product — there is NO maturity benefit; it is pure-risk protection.
Do NOT use 'bonus' or participating-fund language — it is non-participating.
Do NOT imply optional covers (CI/ATPD/ATI/ADB) are automatically included — they are chosen and priced separately.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — they 'may be eligible' subject to the Income Tax Act and are subject to change.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-linked Non-Participating Group Life Insurance Plan'
That benefits/eligibility are governed by the Master Policy and scheme rules
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document for full terms, conditions and exclusions
